facts.fact: ARCOP says the APPEL public procurement platform, in its pilot phase since 14 October 2025, includes an integrated AI-based assistant that guides users on regulatory and technical matters.

SEN.note: The only AI named is in a procurement platform, not a listed sector system.
No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: ARCOP says the APPEL e-procurement platform, launched in pilot on 14 October 2025, has had 15 procedures launched, nine with electronic opening of bids, and publishes procurement plans, tenders and bid openings online.
ARCOP gives figures for APPEL: nearly 400 registered suppliers, over 80 procurement plans published for 2025 and since January 2026, and 15 procedures launched, nine with electronic opening of bids.
